record.original_question: Is that true that for small ϵ > 0, we have (p)| gE (p) (ϵ) ≥ ϵ2c|E , for some constant c (perhaps c = 2π)?

evidence.quote: Question 3.8 (Freedman). Is that true that for small ϵ > 0, we have (p)| gE (p) (ϵ) ≥ ϵ2c|E , for some constant c (perhaps c = 2π)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Sigma_g$ denote a closed oriented surface of genus $g > 0$, and let $p\colon E \to \Sigma_g$ be an oriented circle bundle with Euler class $\mathcal{E}(p) \in H^2(\Sigma_g;\mathbb{Z})$; write $|\mathcal{E}(p)| := |\langle \mathcal{E}(p), [\Sigma_g]\rangle|$. Recall the Milnor–Wood inequality: if $p$ admits a topologically flat structure (i.e. its structure group reduces to a discrete subgroup of $\mathrm{Homeo}_+(S^1)$), then $|\mathcal{E}(p)| \le 2g - 2$.

For $\epsilon > 0$, define
$$g_{\mathcal{E}(p)}(\epsilon) := \min\bigl\{\, g \;:\; \exists\ \text{a generating set } S \text{ of } \pi_1(\Sigma_g) \text{ and a representation } \rho\colon \pi_1(\Sigma_g) \to \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R}) \text{ such that the associated flat } S^1\text{-bundle is isomorphic to } p,$$
$$\text{ and every element of } \rho(S) \text{ lies within sup-norm distance } \epsilon \text{ of the rotation subgroup } U(1) \subset \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R}) \,\bigr\}.$$

Determine whether there exists an absolute constant $c > 0$ such that, for all sufficiently small $\epsilon > 0$ and every circle bundle $p$ over a closed oriented surface,
$$g_{\mathcal{E}(p)}(\epsilon) \;\ge\; \frac{c\,|\mathcal{E}(p)|}{\epsilon^{2}} \;+\; O(\epsilon^{3}).$$
In particular, does this hold with $c = 2\pi$?
artifact.category_tag: Milnor–Wood inequality and flat circle bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem by Freedman in a recent problem list on foliations and diffeomorphism groups (compiled by Nariman and Yazdi, 2025). It asks for a matching lower bound for the controlled Milnor–Wood quantity $g_{\mathcal E(p)}(\epsilon)$ after Freedman established a corresponding upper bound. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Problem list on Foliations and Diffeomorphism groups (arXiv:2503.18274)
status_evidence.snippet: Section 3.4 discusses Freedman's controlled Milnor–Wood inequality and poses Question 3.8 (Freedman) asking for a lower bound g_E(p)(ε) ≥ c|E(p)|/ε² + O(ε³), perhaps with c = 2π.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as an open question by Freedman.
